name: LMV331
description: Single micropower comparator in SOT-23-5, part of the same TI family document as the LMV393 (dual) and LMV339 (quad). Push-pull output (unlike the open-collector LM311/LM393 classics), single-supply 2.7V-5.5V operation. Used on the Bus Pirate 5 (also GSV331, a Gainsil second-source with the same pinout).

SOT-23-5.notes: Per TI's own pin table, DBV/DCK 5-pin SOT-23/SC-70 package. Same physical pin arrangement as the LMV321 op-amp in the same package family, but this is a comparator, not an op-amp: do not substitute one for the other in a linear feedback circuit.

extra.output_type: push-pull (no external pullup needed, unlike LM311/LM393)
extra.Ibias: 0.005uA typ (250nA max) @ Ta=25C (400nA max over -40 to 125C)
extra.response_time: 1000ns typ @ 10mV overdrive (350ns typ @ 100mV overdrive), Vcc=2.7V, RL=5.1k

typical_application: Low-power level detection and threshold sensing in space-constrained, battery-powered designs; push-pull output drives logic directly without a pullup resistor.
gotchas: push-pull output, NOT open-collector; do not add a pullup resistor expecting LM311/LM393 behavior
single-supply part; GND (pin 2) is the negative rail, not necessarily earth ground
GSV331 (Gainsil) is a second-source with the same pinout and similar specs, not an identical die to TI's part; match numbers to whichever is actually on hand
